title: Expanded Welch-Satterthwaite thesis validation: frozen protocol
frozen_before: the full-profile run of run_supervisor_experiment.py that produces the thesis Results chapter numbers

design.strong_null_regime_purpose: Positive control added after the correctness/design audit: P = Q exactly, so a calibrated method must reject at close to the nominal rate here. A failure in this regime indicates an implementation or approximation fault, not a genuine weak-null finite-sample effect, and it is therefore not folded into the same interpretation as the other four regimes.
design.power_effect_definition: Alternative MI is null_mi * (1 + relative_effect); alternative margins are the null pair's own recovered margins with a freshly drawn interaction pattern re-solved to the shifted target MI.

decision_rules.adequate_size_control: Empirical FPR at nominal alpha falls in Bradley's (1978) liberal interval [0.5 * alpha, 1.5 * alpha]. Reported as a pass/fail count per regime/method alongside the continuous mean-absolute-error metric, never in place of it.
decision_rules.acceptable_validity: Valid rate >= 0.90. Below this floor a scenario is reported as a method failure, not folded into a calibration mean.
decision_rules.rejection_rate_denominators: Three denominators are always reported together: fpr (conditional on validity), unconditional_fpr (invalid replicates counted as non-rejections), common_valid_fpr (restricted to replicates where every method is valid, so cross-method rows are always comparable).
decision_rules.size_adjusted_power: Reported as a diagnostic alongside nominal power, using a threshold from an independently seeded null simulation of the same population pair. Not represented as an achievable procedure for a real analysis.

reporting_commitments.disaggregation: Every scenario-method result is retained in scenario_results.csv and power_summary.csv; regime_summary.csv aggregates are never presented without the underlying disaggregation being available.
reporting_commitments.infeasible_configurations: Every (population pair, relative effect) combination that cannot be constructed is logged with a reason in power_infeasible_configurations.csv, not silently dropped.
reporting_commitments.no_post_hoc_regime_changes: The regime and design-parameter definitions in run_supervisor_experiment.py are not altered after this protocol is frozen, except to fix an implementation bug (which would be disclosed).

out_of_scope_for_this_run.constrained_lr: Evaluated separately in run_lr_permutation_comparison.py as a secondary, exploratory comparison. It is not part of this protocol and does not gate any decision about the Expanded Welch method.
out_of_scope_for_this_run.independence_boundary: I(P) = I(Q) = 0 is excluded from the main design as a nonregular boundary case (see docs/theory and Appendix D); it is not swept in this protocol.
